name: Ulster University

sources.title: Applying for your Student visa - Ulster University
topics: your reason for choosing to study at Ulster University
quotes: As part of the CAS assessment process, you may be invited to a Pre-cas interview via CAS shield
The questions in the interview will ask you about your plans for study, your reason for choosing to study at Ulster University, the course, and your finances.
Please ensure that you do not have any notes or websites in front of you during the interview.
A CAS will only be issued if the Pre-CAS interview is complete and successful.
sources.notes: Direct WebFetch returned 403 (Cloudflare); read via a text-reader proxy. Confirms a university-run Pre-CAS interview on CAS Shield, invitations from 'ulster@cas-shield.com'. questionIds are topic-level.

quotes: The interview will be conducted by a member of Home Office staff, who will assess whether you are a 'genuine student' and have the required level of English language proficiency.

It is important that you answer all questions in as much details and as clearly as possible. If your answers are too vague or too brief, the interviewer may not believe that you are a 'genuine student'. You may then be given a second interview or your visa may be refused.
sources.notes: Direct WebFetch 403; read via text-reader proxy. This section is about the Home Office credibility interview at the visa application centre (separate from the CAS Shield pre-CAS interview). Search snippet also: 'you may be asked detailed questions about your new course of study, your previous UK study and immigration history, how you will fund your studies and the reasons you have chosen to study your course in the UK and at Ulster University.'

sources.title: CAS Shield
sources.notes: ulster.cas-shield.com resolves (HTTP 200) and serves Enroly's CAS Shield login page (page text contains 'Enroly' and 'CAS Shield'), so Ulster University uses Enroly CAS Shield for its CAS process. Enroly pre-CAS interviews draw randomised questions from themed banks; no question list is published on the site.
